## Complete Project Structure Analysis

I've thoroughly explored the /workspace directory. Here's a comprehensive summary of the entire project structure:

### Project Overview
This is a **Spring Boot 2.7.18 User Management Microservice** using Java 1.8, with Maven as the build tool. It's a legacy application with security configurations and RESTful APIs for user management.

### Directory Structure

```
/workspace/
├── pom.xml                                 (Build configuration)
└── src/
    ├── main/
    │   ├── java/com/example/userservice/
    │   │   ├── UserServiceApplication.java        (Main entry point)
    │   │   ├── config/
    │   │   │   ├── SecurityConfig.java            (Deprecated WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter)
    │   │   │   ├── CustomUserDetailsService.java  (UserDetailsService implementation)
    │   │   │   └── UserSecurity.java              (Custom security expressions)
    │   │   ├── controller/
    │   │   │   └── UserController.java            (REST endpoints for user management)
    │   │   ├── service/
    │   │   │   ├── UserService.java               (Business logic for user operations)
    │   │   │   └── ExternalApiService.java        (External API integration)
    │   │   ├── repository/
    │   │   │   └── UserRepository.java            (JPA repository for data access)
    │   │   ├── model/
    │   │   │   ├── User.java                      (User entity with JPA annotations)
    │   │   │   └── Role.java                      (Role enum: USER, ADMIN, MODERATOR)
    │   │   ├── dto/
    │   │   │   ├── UserDTO.java                   (Data transfer object)
    │   │   │   └── CreateUserRequest.java         (Request validation DTO)
    │   │   └── exception/
    │   │       └── GlobalExceptionHandler.java    (Global exception handling)
    │   └── resources/
    │       └── application.properties              (Main application configuration)
    └── test/
        ├── java/com/example/userservice/
        │   └── UserServiceApplicationTests.java    (Integration tests)
        └── resources/
            └── application-test.properties         (Test configuration)
```

### Complete File Listing (All 17 Files)

**Root Configuration:**
- /workspace/pom.xml

**Main Source Code (13 Java files):**
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/UserServiceApplication.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/model/User.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/model/Role.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/controller/UserController.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/service/UserService.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/service/ExternalApiService.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/repository/UserRepository.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/dto/UserDTO.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/dto/CreateUserRequest.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/config/SecurityConfig.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/config/CustomUserDetailsService.java
- /workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/config/UserSecurity.java

**Configuration Files (2 files):**
- /workspace/src/main/resources/application.properties
- /workspace/src/test/resources/application-test.properties

**Test Files (1 file):**
- /workspace/src/test/java/com/example/userservice/UserServiceApplicationTests.java

### Build Configuration Summary (pom.xml)

**Project Metadata:**
- GroupId: com.example
- ArtifactId: userservice
- Version: 1.0.0
- Name: User Service
- Description: Legacy User Management Microservice
- Parent: spring-boot-starter-parent:2.7.18
- Java Version: 1.8

**Dependencies:**
- Spring Boot Web (REST APIs)
- Spring Boot Data JPA (Database access)
- Spring Boot Validation (Input validation)
- Spring Boot Security (Authentication/Authorization)
- H2 Database (In-memory database)
- JWT (jjwt:0.9.1) for token handling
- JAXB API 2.3.1 (Java 8 compatibility)
- Spring Security Test
- Spring Boot Test

### Key Architectural Components

1. **User Entity Model** - JPA entity with validation, timestamps (createdAt, updatedAt), and role-based access control
2. **RESTful Controller** - 9 endpoints for user CRUD operations with role-based authorization
3. **Service Layer** - Business logic with password encoding and data validation
4. **Repository Layer** - JPA repository with custom queries for searching and filtering
5. **Security Configuration** - Stateless, CSRF-disabled, with role-based method security
6. **Exception Handling** - Global exception handler with custom error responses
7. **External Integration** - RestTemplate-based service for calling external APIs
8. **Test Suite** - Integration tests using JUnit 5 and Spring Boot Test

### Configuration Details

**Main Properties (application.properties):**
- Server port: 8080
- H2 in-memory database: jdbc:h2:mem:userdb
- H2 console enabled at /h2-console
- Hibernate DDL auto: create-drop
- External API base URL: https://api.example.com
- Debug logging for userservice and security

**Test Properties (application-test.properties):**
- Separate H2 test database: jdbc:h2:mem:testdb
- H2 console disabled for tests
- Mock external API at http://localhost:8089
- Reduced logging (WARN level)
